description: K₃Na₂LiTeO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.63-3.23 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.63-3.03 Å. In the third K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.60-2.88 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.55 Å. Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.05 Å. Te is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.00 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, one Li, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two K, two Na, one Li, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, one Li, and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four K, two Na, and one Te atom to form distorted edge-sharing OK₄Na₂Te pentagonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three K, two Na, and one Te atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two K, two Na, one Li, and one Te atom.
